articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show substantial gains in graduate-level math, scientific reasoning, and complex code generation, narrowing the gap with specialized domain models.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Introduces Gemini Ultra 2 with Real-Time Agentic Capabilities
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which integrates persistent memory and autonomous multi-step task execution across Google's ecosystem. The model can independently manage workflows spanning Gmail, Docs, and third-party APIs, marking a significant step toward production-grade AI agents with robust tool use.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Factories
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has entered limited deployment at two of its manufacturing facilities, performing parts sorting, bin picking, and simple assembly tasks. The company reports a 40% improvement in dexterous manipulation over Gen 2, driven by a new sim-to-real reinforcement learning pipeline.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Pilot to Full Assembly Line Integration
articles.summary: Figure AI announced that its Figure 02 humanoid robots have moved beyond pilot testing at BMW's Spartanburg plant and are now integrated into a full vehicle assembly line. The robots handle ergonomically challenging tasks using vision-language model-driven planning, reducing worker injury reports in target zones by over 60%.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Breakthrough Interpretability Framework for Large Language Models
articles.summary: Anthropic released a comprehensive mechanistic interpretability framework that can trace specific model behaviors to identifiable circuit-level features in transformer architectures with over 100B parameters. The work enables engineers to diagnose and selectively suppress hallucination pathways, representing a major advance in AI safety and model debugging.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process technology, several months ahead of its original roadmap. The node delivers an 18% speed improvement and 22% power reduction over N2, with early yields reportedly exceeding expectations, positioning it for next-generation AI accelerator chips in 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations at Record Fidelity
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly demonstrated fault-tolerant operations on logical qubits with error rates below 10⁻⁶, a critical milestone for practical quantum computing. The achievement leverages Microsoft's new qubit virtualization layer and Quantinuum's H3 trapped-ion hardware, moving the industry closer to commercially relevant quantum advantage.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth as Open-Weight Model with MoE Architecture
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, a massive mixture-of-experts open-weight model with 288B active parameters routed from a reported 2T total. It matches or exceeds proprietary frontier models on major benchmarks while remaining available under a permissive license, intensifying the open-source vs. closed-source AI capabilities debate.
